nodes.label: bob
nodes.summary: Bob — Telegram-native companion agent: GUPPI process, LLM Tier 0/1 router with privacy redaction, SQLite+FTS5 memory, Higher Mind, Genesis, heartbeat. Two admin bots in one process (BOB-003): a MultiBotGateway (BotRegistry) polls both Bob and GUPPI, dedups cross-bot by (chat_id, message_id), and a central router dispatches by identity+scope — Bob lives in his forum topic, GUPPI is the gatekeeper in General with a visible unauthorized reject + owner commands. aiogram transport (native draft streaming + Rich Messages), owner/allowlist/chat-scope authz, resilient ticks, and a capability seam (registry + tool-loop) executed by GUPPI.

nodes.label: bob-application
nodes.summary: GUPPI orchestration: AgentRuntime + AsyncEventBus, LLMRouter (tier routing + privacy redaction), use-cases (HandleMessage, RunGenesis, UpdateMoodFromText), resilient heartbeat ticks (retry/backoff), the Authorizer access policy and the capability seam (CapabilityRegistry + ToolLoop + recall_memory). Depends on domain via ports; never imports infrastructure.

nodes.label: bob-domain
nodes.summary: Umbrella of the seven module-vertical bounded contexts (personality, conversation, memory, proactivity, coding, capabilities, social) plus the shared `kernel` (infra-neutral cross-module contracts — the domain LAYER proper). Each vertical spans domain+usecases+adapters inside its own boundary; the kernel is pure logic + Protocol definitions: no I/O, no LLM, no transport.

nodes.label: bob-infrastructure
nodes.summary: Port adapters: aiogram Telegram gateway (long-polling + authz gate, native draft streaming, Rich Messages, markdown<->RichMessage, topic-thread reply pinning), MultiBotGateway (BotRegistry + cross-bot dedup + central identity/scope router) and the GuppiHandler gatekeeper (visible reject + owner commands), OpenAI-compatible LLM provider (Tier 0/1 + tool-calling), SQLite+FTS5 persistence, KvAllowlistStore and SoulStore, two-bot layered config loader.

nodes.label: capabilities
nodes.summary: Capabilities module («Bob's tools») — the full vertical GUPPI tool seam in one place: `ports.py` (Capability contract + web/url/diagram/introspection/outbound ports; the LLM tool-calling vocabulary lives in `kernel`, BOB-113) + pure `diagrams`/`introspection` cores (PrivacyGuard, tracker intent/digest, graph form + impact digest, health form + health digest — every dynamic argv slot is validated and every long report is condensed BEFORE it reaches a chat), `usecases/` (CapabilityRegistry + ToolLoop and the skills: recall/search memory, read code/url, web search, render diagram, progress announcer; repo navigation — list_dir / find_file / read_code (BOB-067); read-only dev introspection — recent_commits git history + list_tasks / show_task / task_comments over the beads tracker (BOB-081); and the read-only beadloom trio — draw_architecture (the mermaid source of the graph), architecture_impact («что сломается, если тронуть X») and project_health (status / prime / doctor / sync-check / lint / diff) (BOB-091)), and `adapters/` (aiohttp URL reader behind an SSRF guard, mermaid renderer, beadloom/bd/git introspector over a fixed read-only allowlist — never a shell, Qwen web-search transport). Domain-first slice BOB-062.4.

nodes.label: coding
nodes.summary: Coding module («Bob writes code») — the GATED vertical (plan → approve → PR) plus the shared coding-session surface: `ports.py` + pure domain logic (state/naming/sandbox+push policy/stream-json), `usecases/` orchestration, and `adapters/` (Claude Code CLI, git worktree, gh PR, session store, indicator). Domain-first slice BOB-062.1; the live terminal split out into `interactive` in BOB-087.E.

nodes.label: config
nodes.summary: Config adapter — two-bot layered config loader (env + files) for the running process.

nodes.label: conversation
nodes.summary: Conversation module («how a turn is conducted») — the full turn-conduct vertical in one place: `ports.py` (conversation-floor store, closer log, ZoneClassifier) + pure domain (addressivity, conversation + floor continuity, brevity, engagement, zone classifier, interim line, response choice, response/volatility judgments), `usecases/` (decide_response), and `adapters/` (Tier-0 response/volatility/interim judges + SQLite conversation-floor & closer-log stores). Depends on personality one-directionally. Domain-first slice BOB-062.6a.

nodes.label: identity
nodes.summary: Identity module («кем Боб представляется GitHub'у») — github-идентичность как отдельный bounded context: чистые ядра (Purpose→Principal — work пушит только в форк, propose лишь читает апстрим; реквизиты принципала из конфига с проверкой формы; claims App-JWT RS256 с поправкой на расхождение часов и предел GitHub; вердикт «токен годен / пора обновить» с обновлением ЗАРАНЕЕ, а не по факту 401) и `adapters/` (подпись настоящим `openssl dgst -sha256 -sign` — без новых зависимостей; транспорт двух ручек GitHub App API на aiohttp — секрет только в заголовке, никогда в argv; кэш installation-токенов на принципала). Заведён в BOB-089 срез B; `coding` его не импортит, провайдер приходит на композиции.

nodes.label: interactive
nodes.summary: Interactive module («Боб держит живой терминал») — the live bidirectional `claude` session in the owner's DM: pure domain (mode intent, resume policy + negotiation, argv policy, the mode's voice, the live-session holder), `usecases/` (session manager, teardown, DM intake router, boot-time sweep of orphaned sessions), and `adapters/` (the persistent stream-json runner). Rests on coding's shared session surface; coding never imports it. Split out of `coding` in BOB-087.E.

nodes.label: kernel
nodes.summary: Shared kernel — the infra-neutral contracts every vertical module rests on: the runtime seams (Clock, EventBus, EventHandler, DomainEvent, LLMProvider), the shared value objects (LLMMessage, JsonValue), the intake events (MessageReceived, BobMessageReaction), the memory/reply ports (EpisodeReader, MemoryRecall, Recalled, ReplyGateway, BobUserIdSource), the LLM tool-calling vocabulary (ToolDefinition, ToolCall, ToolCallResult, ToolCallingProvider, ToolLoopMessage), the self-improvement RuleModulators, and the social vocabulary — who talks to Bob and how he stands with them (Interlocutor, InterlocutorKind, Trust, Gender, Relationship, RosterMember, SulkState) — whose behaviour stays in `social` (BOB-113). Pure Protocol/type/value definitions; no I/O. Every module may import from here; the kernel imports from no module.

nodes.label: llm
nodes.summary: LLM adapter — OpenAI-compatible provider for Tier 0/1 completion + tool-calling (Ollama/Qwen backend).

nodes.label: memory
nodes.summary: Memory module («Bob remembers») — the full vertical capability in one place: `ports.py` (MemoryRepo, SelfActionRecorder, Embedder, Reranker — the read ports MemoryRecall/EpisodeReader and `Recalled` live in `kernel`, BOB-113) + pure `entities`, `usecases/` (extract facts, consolidate, dedup), and `adapters/` (FTS5/hybrid recall + local Ollama embedder/reranker). Domain-first slice BOB-062.2.

nodes.label: persistence
nodes.summary: Persistence kernel — the shared `SqliteConnection` (open/WAL/foreign_keys/sqlite-vec load/`schema.sql`/kv/close) that the memory adapter and the 13 per-module durable stores read through the injected `connection` seam. Pure I/O: carries no memory/business logic — those realisations live in their owning modules' `adapters/` (BOB-062.2–.7b).

nodes.label: personality
nodes.summary: Personality module («who Bob is») — the full character vertical in one place: `ports.py` + pure domain (Mood five-axis affect, TasteEngine + evolution, disposition, fascination + phantoms, language/profanity, expression incl. verbosity/engagement vocabulary, voice, the reaction family, negotiation stance, reflection, absence), `usecases/` (update mood from text, apply/reappraise/parse reflection, evolve fascination/phantoms), and `adapters/` (Tier-0 reaction judge + SQLite/kv fascination & notable-reaction stores). Domain-first slice BOB-062.6a. (Being-received reaction perception is a cross-domain use-case over mood + relationship, so it lives in `application/usecases/perceive_reaction`, not here.)

nodes.label: presence
nodes.summary: Presence module («Bob's living rhythm») — the ритм-слой of human group presence: `ports.py` + pure domain (OutgoingActivity rolling window, ShareOfVoicePolicy soft ambient ceiling with focus-bypass, NaturalDelayPolicy human reply floor, ReactionBudget gentle like budget, RhythmConfig tunables) + `adapters/` (episodic-log OutgoingActivityStore). Domain-first slice BOB-066.2.3; inert behind the `presence.rhythm` flag until the epic ships.

nodes.label: proactivity
nodes.summary: Proactivity module («Bob's background life») — the full vertical capability in one place: `ports.py` + pure domain (drive-model urge/governance/social-energy, goals graph, self-improvement rules — the RuleModulators value they build lives in `kernel`, BOB-113), `usecases/` (engine/tick, plan/pursue goals, detect-patterns/announce-rules), and `adapters/` (proactivity/goal/self-improvement stores + live read-seams). Domain-first slice BOB-062.3.

nodes.label: router
nodes.summary: LLMRouter — Tier 0/1 model routing with privacy redaction before any model call.

nodes.label: runtime
nodes.summary: Composition root (`src/bob/runtime/` package + the thin `app.py` shim) — the only layer allowed to wire all layers + all vertical modules at once: `config.py` loads layered config (incl. `_REPO_ROOT`), `wiring/*` build infrastructure adapters + compose application policy/use-cases per bounded context, `composition.py` (`build_application` + `Application`) subscribes handlers to the EventBus and registers ticks + Telegram polling, `clock.py` provides `SystemClock`, and `main.py` runs Genesis once and starts the process.

nodes.label: runtime-app
nodes.summary: Application runtime — AgentRuntime, AsyncEventBus, and resilient heartbeat ticks (retry/backoff); the intake events it carries live in the shared kernel. Distinct from the `runtime` composition root.

nodes.label: social
nodes.summary: Social module («Bob distinguishes people») — the full vertical capability in one place: `ports.py` + pure domain behaviour over the shared-kernel social values (classify an interlocutor, self-gender inference, first-impression, relationship accrual, roster building, sulk dynamics — the values Interlocutor/Gender/Relationship/RosterMember/SulkState live in `kernel`, BOB-113) + `permission/` value objects, `usecases/` (authorizer/sender+reactor perception, permission flow/execution, first-impression/relationship/sulk sources, run-genesis), and `adapters/` (first-impression/relationship/sulk/allowlist/permission-request/soul stores + privilege-judge). Domain-first slice BOB-062.5.

nodes.label: telegram
nodes.summary: Telegram adapter — aiogram gateway (long-polling, authz gate, native draft streaming, Rich Messages, topic-thread reply pinning), MultiBotGateway (BotRegistry + cross-bot dedup + identity/scope router) and the GuppiHandler gatekeeper.

nodes.label: usecases
nodes.summary: Use-cases — HandleMessage, RunGenesis, UpdateMoodFromText, goal/memory/reflection flows orchestrating domain + ports.
